notes.title: Feedback collection
notes.content:
The EA version of Mecha Party was officially launched on January 17th. Our goal is to operate this casual VR+MOBA competitive game in the long term. We hope you like it. If you have any feedback, you can always submit it. Thank you very much.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819101/415dd0fd855a065ee22b7516b531b86fdc2d3f76.png[/img]

notes.title: Mecha party EA version is officially launched!!!
notes.content:
Dear players, we are happy to announce that our new VR game "Mecha Party" islaunched officially! 

This is a mecha combat game that includes multiplayer MOBA battles and single-player challenges. You can pilot your favorite mecha here, compete with other players, or challenge various levels in the game. We believe that this game will bring you an unprecedented fully immersive mecha driving VR experience. Stay tuned to our Community Center for more information about Mecha Party. We look forward to having you join us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819101/c2bd2a7019f3433692ab4908b962e28974f2bc89.png[/img]
